attr.title: The Dishwasher: Vampire Smile
attr.desc: A fast-paced, combo-driven 2D action platformer by Ska Studios with a gritty graphic-novel art style. Play as Yuki or The Dishwasher and slash your way through the campaign, the arcade levels and the Dish Challenge.
attr.inst: Copy the contents of your Steam Windows depot (App 268990, Depot 268991) into thedishwashervampiresmile/gamedata/. Download via Steam console: download_depot 268990 268991. The first start runs a one-time setup (texture conversion and patching) that takes about 20 minutes and asks once for your button layout.
attr.inst_md:
Copy the contents of your Steam Windows build of The Dishwasher: Vampire Smile into the `ports/thedishwashervampiresmile/gamedata` directory.

To get the Windows depot via Steam console, run:

```
download_depot 268990 268991
```

Required files include `VampireSmile.exe` and the `Content` folder.

On first launch, the port will automatically set up and convert assets. This may take about 20 minutes. You are asked once which button layout and language you want.
